description.value:
Dread shadow billows out from a point you choose within range to fill a 60-foot-radius sphere for the duration, wrapping around corners as it spreads. Creatures with darkvision cannot see through it, and mundane light or light from powers of 8th level or lower cannot pierce it.

Ghastly shrieks and mad laughter echo through the sphere. Any creature that begins its turn inside must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 8d8 psychic damage, half as much on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 8
